_comment: Kannada word/phrase -> ordered ISL sign IDs (Kannada-to-Sign). Keys are normalized Kannada (NFC, no punctuation). 'sign_ids' is the sign sequence in ISL gloss order (which can differ from Kannada word order); animation clips are looked up per sign ID in animation_mapping.json. Phrase keys are matched before single words (longest match first). 'verified' is false for every entry: these are prototype lexical/phrase lookups NOT yet reviewed by an ISL expert. Set verified=true and fill 'reviewer' only after review.
